paper_title: MADLLM Multivariate Anomaly Detection via Pre-trained LLMs
caption: : F1 score results
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the F1 score percentages for five different language models: SMD, PSM, SWAT, SMAP, and MSL, compared to MADLLM and MADLLM w/o feature embedding and MADLLM w/o skip embedding. The horizontal axis represents the model names, listed alphabetically from left to right, while the vertical axis displays the F1 score percentage, ranging from approximately 80% to 100%. The vertical axis is labeled “F1 Score (%)” and has a linear scale with tick intervals of 10%, starting at 80% and ending at 100%. The bars, colored in varying shades of gray, represent the F1 score for each model.  SMD has an F1 score of approximately 86%, PSM has an F1 score of approximately 83%, SWAT has an F1 score of approximately 81%, SMAP has an F1 score of approximately 88%, and MSL has an F1 score of approximately 91%. The MADLLM model has an F1 score of approximately 83%, MADLLM w/o feature embedding has an F1 score of approximately 87%, and MADLLM w/o skip embedding has an F1 score of approximately 94%. All bars are presented in descending order based on F1 score.
